execution_protocol.precision: float64 / complex128; validated CUDA kernel unchanged; --fmad=false
execution_protocol.wst: Frozen standard CPU WST, unchanged inputs, settings, path order and descriptors
execution_protocol.retries: Restart each capped lead from initialization at the frozen iteration limits; append all attempts before retry/failure; final nonconvergence stops the run, never excludes a record
execution_protocol.reuse: Copy all verified completed CPU feature checkpoints, byte-identical NPZ files, with original metadata and attempt-log hashes in the new manifest; record CPU origin per ECG
execution_protocol.pilot: Recompute the same 16 label-independent fit ECGs with the integrated runner; VMD features atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-5; WST and names exact; physical input, iterations, limits and all retry attempts exact; Kymatio reference on the original two engineering ECGs
execution_protocol.resume: Per-record NPZ and completion metadata committed atomically; verify all completed records before skipping; SIGINT/SIGTERM finishes the current batch then stops; an abrupt crash repeats at most the unfinished part of one batch
execution_protocol.failure: Retain traceback, batch identities, all attempt logs and completed checkpoints; do not proceed automatically after numerical failure
execution_protocol.scope: 17,905 eligible fit/validation ECGs; no official-test waveform access, model fitting, feature selection or accuracy-based decisions

input.unit: one full 10-second 12-lead ECG per feature row

split.official_test: reserved; no feature extraction or predictions in this runner

vmd.features: 28 mode descriptors per mode per lead; concatenate leads
vmd.unconverged: stop and log; do not exclude or silently accept

wst.pooling: mean of log coefficients over time for orders 1/2; signed linear order 0

preprocessing.scaler: training StandardScaler then tanh times pi/2

controls.dummy: always-negative predictions and constant fit-partition prevalence scores

evaluation.uncertainty: paired patient-cluster bootstrap of validation ECG predictions; average differences across all three VQC seeds
evaluation.interpretation: internal validation only; no quantum advantage or clinical deployment claim

engineering_check.selection: smallest SHA-256 of protocol id plus record id among fit records; labels unused
engineering_check.kymatio_reference: all leads of each engineering-check record at the same settings

initial_timing.scope: Batch wall time includes record loading, GPU VMD, CPU descriptors/WST, verification and checkpoint writes; startup preflight excluded
